Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
You look pretty serious. Did something happen？
I went to a cat cafe the other day. There was this one girl who just wouldn't warm up to me.
A cat cafe？ Huh. Well, cats can be pretty fickle.
Yeah, but the second I saw her, something just clicked. I knew we could be friends!
Hmm. Why not try winning her over with food？
Food...？
Yeah. Like canned mackerel or something.
Hah...
Haha, right. You can't feed a cat canned mackerel meant for people.
You can't win a cat over with something as shallow as bribing it with food! You don't get it at all.
...I spoke out of turn.
Huh？ Is that a scratch on your hand？
Kobayakawa
Oh, this？ Got it at the cat cafe.
So you went back again.
I have to keep going until I get her to notice me.
And your beloved lady friend ended up scratching you, huh？ Rough.
It's just a light scratch, no big deal. I made sure to disinfect it, too.
You look awfully happy for someone who just got scratched.
Because she actually came up to me on her own. Hehe, that's progress.
(To think she'd have ▲小早川＊▲ this smitten...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, listen. That girl finally fell asleep right next to me!!
That girl？
Yeah, right beside me, showing her belly and purring...
Oh, the cat cafe. Guess she might let you pet her soon, huh？
No way! Girls are delicate. If you just start touching them out of nowhere, they'll hate you.
Is that how it is？
That's how it is.
I see... Girls are delicate, so no touching them out of nowhere, huh.
...What？
Oh, nothing？
Hmph. Dirty old man.
(...Guess she saw right through me.)
What's wrong？ You look kind of lonely.
Kobayakawa
I went to the cat cafe, and she wasn't there anymore.
Why？ Did she get sick or something？
No. Apparently they paired her up with a mate recently, and she's having kittens.
Oh, well that's great news then, isn't it？
I guess. But I won't be able to see her for a while until she gives birth. ...I'm gonna miss her.
She'll be back before you know it, with cute little kittens in tow.
...Yeah, you're right. Plus, she found someone special of her own, so she must be happy.
Yeah, just like how you found me, ▲小早川＊▲!
Haha...
You always say one thing too many. Still, if she's as happy as I am right now, I guess I can rest easy.
Kobayakawa
Remember how I told you about Volvavin？
The one your little brother's into, right.
Right there.
Wait, is he still making you play Volvavin with him？
No. He found a Volvavin model kit at the toy store.
Oh, a model kit, huh.
Yeah, and I ended up agreeing to build it with him.
Can you even build model kits, ▲小早川＊▲？
...I'm his big sister. I'll do my best for my little brother.
Gotcha. Not sure how much help I'll be, but you can always ask me for advice.
Yeah.
Kobayakawa
Model kits are harder than I thought.
I don't think it's that hard if you just follow the instructions.
That's the hard part, okay？ Plus there are way too many pieces.
Right... Didn't the ads say Volvavin fully transforms and combines, or something？
Maybe I picked one that was too hard to start with...
Yeah, you might be right.
*Sigh*... Wish someone would build it for me.
I can help, if you don't mind me doing it.
...Hmm, no way. This is when I have to show him what a capable big sister I am.
(Guess she really wants to build it for him herself...)
Kobayakawa
...Hey, can I ask you something？
Hm？ What's up？
It's about the Volvavin model.
Oh, did you decide you want my help after all？
I didn't say anything like that.
Then what's the question？
The other day, I saw a Gaston X model kit at the toy store.
Gaston...？ Oh, isn't that Volvavin's rival robot？
Don't you think it'd look way cooler having the two of them displayed together？
...I think you should finish Volvavin first before worrying about that.
Yeah... except I already bought it.
(Then why even bother asking me...？)
By the way, how did that Volvavin model turn out？
Kobayakawa
Don't tell me it didn't go well...
You really shouldn't underestimate me, you know？
Oh, so then...
Of course I finished it. Hehe.
Nice, congrats. Bet your brother was thrilled.
Yeah, pretty much. I almost wish I could show you Volvavin in all its glory.
What about Gaston X？
Obviously. The two of them are battling it out on top of our bookshelf right now.
Huh. Honestly, ▲小早川＊▲, I thought you were way more clumsy.
...Clumsy？
Yeah...
Vol-kiiiiick!!
Kobayakawa
Hey, I need some advice.
What is it？
What's a good gift to get for a hospital visit？
A hospital visit？ Is someone sick or something？
No. Remember Ms. Hanamaki, the English teacher？ She's on maternity leave.
Oh, that's what you meant.
So the class is talking about sending her something to wish for a healthy baby.
A baby gift, huh. Well, it's not like I've ever given birth myself...
...Obviously not. ...I shouldn't have bothered asking you.
Just kidding. Still, wouldn't the girls in your class know better than a guy would？
Maybe so. Guess I'll go do that, then.
Kobayakawa
About that thing with Ms. Hanamaki.
Oh, right, the baby gift.
The class decided to send her flowers. Feels a little too safe, though.
It's coming from her students, so I'm sure she'll be happy with anything.
I hope so.
...Hey, what are you grinning about？
You joined in the talk too, right, ▲小早川＊▲？ You used to hate that stuff.
It's not like I enjoy that kind of thing now, either.
Still, that's progress. It's a good thing.
*Sigh*... Nosy old man.
Kobayakawa
That plan to send flowers to Ms. Hanamaki isn't really going anywhere.
Really？ All that's left is picking what kind of flowers to send, isn't it？
Yeah, well, that's what everyone's arguing over.
What kind of flowers do you like for it, ▲小早川＊▲？
Hmm... I liked the potted tulips I saw at the florist by the station recently.
Wait, aren't potted plants bad luck for hospital visits？
Oh... Because they 'take root' in bed, right？ Even for a happy occasion？
Umm... I forget, actually.
Not very thorough, are you.
Sorry.
Oh well. Best to leave it to the pros. I'll just ask the florist.
That's the right call.
Kobayakawa
Hey. A few of us from class went to visit Ms. Hanamaki in the hospital.
Oh, the baby was born.
Yeah. She let us see the newborn baby, too.
How was it？
It squeezed my finger with its tiny little hand. Ahh, seriously, it was too cute!
Huh. Does seeing that kind of thing make you want a baby of your own？
Ow... What was that for!
Sexual harassment.
(Why！？)
What kind of magazines do you usually read, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Why do you ask？
I just always picture you reading thick books.
I read magazines too, you know. I'm just not really into whatever's trendy with kids these days...
"Kids these days"？ You're one of them, ▲小早川＊▲.
I'm not talking about age. Don't you get it？
Why？
I mean on the inside. Besides, what girl these days could handle an old man like you？
(Pretty sure I count as a kid these days too, though...)
Kobayakawa
Remember how we talked about magazines the other day？ What kind do you read？
...Mostly manga magazines, I guess. Like Weekly Dash and stuff like that.
Hmm... So, magazines with girls in swimsuits...
...Huh？ I said manga.
Who knows what you're really buying them for.
I told you, for the manga.
Well, doesn't matter to me either way. Good grief.
(Talk about a false accusation...)
Hm？ Are you in a bad mood or something？
Kobayakawa
The fashion magazine I was gonna buy was sold out.
Eh！？
Why are you so surprised？ Is it really that weird for me to read a fashion magazine？
Didn't you say the other day that you don't read them？
I never said I don't read them. I'm pretty flexible about that stuff.
...Are you？ So, what were you after in that magazine？
...A special feature.
Of what？
On fashion.
(Well, obviously, but...)
Kobayakawa
You look weirdly happy. Did something happen？
About that feature in the fashion magazine you tried to buy the other day, ▲小早川＊▲.
Eh？
Wasn't it "Lovable Outfits Just for Your Boyfriend"？
W-What！？ No it wasn't！
Really？ A girl in my class was reading it, so I was sure that was the one.
As if. Don't get all excited over nothing.
Sorry. I just thought it'd make me really happy if you were thinking about stuff like that, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Hmm. Is that right.
Hm？
Nothing！
Kobayakawa
Boys are seriously way too immature.
So you're not gonna ask what happened？
You looked pretty grumpy, so I figured it was better not to ask...
This is where you're supposed to ask.
Okay, okay. What happened？
Whatever. The boys in my class are getting all worked up over some rumor about a ghost in the library.
A ghost？ I haven't heard anything about that.
I don't know anything about it either, and I couldn't care less. Yet they keep coming up to tell me about it.
To you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Because I'm on the library committee, apparently. Last I checked, ghost hunting wasn't part of the job.
(...Can't argue with that.)
Kobayakawa
I told an upperclassman on the library committee about that ghost rumor.
You should just ignore it. It's just a silly rumor.
That's what they said, too.
Right？
Yeah, but it's all anyone in my class talks about.
Is that rumor still going？
It's only spreading more. Not that I care about it.
So you just don't care？ You're not scared of ghosts？
Huh？ Nobody said anything about being scared.
Huh... Right there. Behind you, ▲小早川＊▲... There's something there.
!? D-Don't say creepy stuff like that, seriously!
(She didn't have to jump like that...)
Kobayakawa
Sigh... I wish people would give that ghost story a rest already.
It still hasn't died down？ You'd think people would've moved on by now.
On the surface, sure. But it sounds like the boys are planning a test of courage.
A test of courage... So they're going in at night, huh.
Boys are seriously so childish. As if ghosts are even real.
It doesn't matter if it's real or not. Half the fun with stuff like this is planning it.
Now you're talking like them, too.
Come on, isn't being at school at night kind of exciting？
I don't get the appeal at all.
Besides, what would they even do if a ghost actually showed up？
There was a big commotion around school earlier, wasn't there？
Kobayakawa
Remember how the boys were talking about doing a test of courage？ Apparently they snuck into school in the middle of the night and set off the alarm.
Aw, man...
Their parents got called in too, and they got chewed out big time. Serves them right.
So, was there actually a ghost？
Turned out it was just a loose door in the archive room. Like I said, there's no way ghosts are—
Oh, sorry. Dropped my phone.
D-Don't scare me like that!
...Are you sure you're not just easily scared？
I wasn't scared, you just startled me! Idiot.
(She doesn't have to get so defensive...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, are you into room decor and stuff like that？
I don't know if I'd say I'm into it, personally. Though people who care about that stuff really go all out.
My mom's pretty into it. And apparently a new home decor shop opened a bit far from here.
Oh yeah, I think they did a feature on it on TV the other day.
She says she wants to go check it out sometime.
Going by that look on your face, you don't wanna go？
It's not that. I just don't plan on changing my room, so I figure I'll be bored.
You never know, it might be more fun than you think once you get there.
I hope you're right.
Kobayakawa
Looks like I'm going to that home decor shop I told you about after all.
I see. Well, since you're going, try to have fun.
Yeah, except my mom said I might as well redecorate my room while we're at it.
And you don't really want to, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
Right. Simple is best.
...Pretty straightforward.
I like how it is now, but she says I should go for a cuter style...
A cuter style, huh...
...What, is that funny？
Not at all. I think a cute style could be nice.
...Easy for you to say. Still, seeing how excited my mom is makes it hard to say no.
Did you go to that home decor shop you mentioned the other day？
Kobayakawa
Not yet. We decided to go as a family on my dad's day off.
So when you get back, your room's gonna get a cute makeover, ▲小早川＊▲.
...What？ Are you looking forward to it or something？
A little, yeah.
Quit grinning. I doubt it's gonna get as cute as you're hoping for.
Really？ If you're gonna do it, you might as well go all the way.
I have lines I won't cross, too. I'm definitely putting my foot down on that.
(I can't wait to see how her room turns out.)
Kobayakawa
I went to that home decor shop.
Oh, the one you mentioned. How was it？
More fun than I expected. You could simulate all kinds of layouts on a computer.
Wow, I didn't know we had those.
It's like a puzzle. It's fun trying out all sorts of different combinations.
Sounds neat. ...So how are things with redecorating？
Never better.
Oh, going with the cute style then!
Not like that. I shut that plan right down. Even got my mom to agree to it.
Oh...
You don't have to look so disappointed. If you insist, I'll think about it... in the future.
(In the future, huh... Wait, the future？)
Kobayakawa
Having a hardcore hobbyist in the house is a bit of a pain. I wish he'd tone it down.
Which girl？
My dad. He's always had a lot of hobbies, and now apparently it's cameras.
Getting serious about that sounds like a lot of work...
He seems to be keeping it within his allowance, at least. It's just...
What's wrong？
As his daughter, getting roped into modeling for him is rough.
Come on, it wouldn't hurt to model for him a little.
Yeah, except he's always saying stuff like, "Great pose!" or "That look is so cute!" Even in public.
(Okay, yeah, that would be pretty embarrassing...)
Is your dad still keeping up with the photography thing？
Kobayakawa
Ugh, yeah, more or less...
And you're still his model, ▲小早川＊▲？
Technically it's the whole family, but I feel like I'm getting the worst of it.
Don't put it like that. He probably just wants a record of his daughter growing up.
People don't grow in ten-minute intervals, you know.
Haha, fair point. Well, he couldn't ask for a better model than you, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Hey, don't just casually slip embarrassing lines like that into the conversation.
(No good, huh... And here I thought I slipped that in pretty smoothly.)
Kobayakawa
Don't you think taking a family portrait at this point is kind of embarrassing？
Hm？ Oh, is this about your dad's camera again？
Now that he's finally eased up on me, he says he wants a group family photo next.
Sounds nice to me. You don't want to？
Easy for you to say. I wouldn't mind if we were just taking a normal picture, but...
Hm？
I can tell he's up to something. He keeps saying a normal family photo would be boring.
Not normal...？ Like what？
Who knows, but Dad's the only one super excited about it...
Whatever happened with that family photo？ You know, the one your dad wanted to take.
Kobayakawa
Oh, that.
What was it again, an "interesting" photo？
...Yeah. He even started talking about renting out a studio for it.
A studio, huh？ That's serious business. Why not just have fun with it, ▲小早川＊▲？
Come on, I just want a normal family photo. Those things stick around forever.
...Good point. If it's a weird photo, it might be rough looking back on it years from now.
Right？ So Mom and I had to team up to stop him. A family photo in mascot costumes？ No way.
(Mascot costumes... I kinda wanted to see that. Too bad.)
Kobayakawa
My little brother brings his friends over a lot, and honestly, kids are pretty cute.
Yeah, they're so innocent and full of energy.
Though obviously, my brother is the cutest one of all.
Haha, someone's a doting big sister.
Call me whatever you want. Cute is cute.
Come to think of it, do the two of you ever fight？
Of course not. Come on, he's still just a little kid.
(I think ▲小早川＊▲ has her own childish side too, though...)
▲小早川＊▲, is that a bruise on your hand？
Kobayakawa
Oh... I was playing superheroes with my brother and his friends. I must've bumped it.
You even play along with stuff like that, huh.
Yeah. It's like boys have way too much energy.
...Sounds like it's tough just keeping up with them.
Even if it's just pretend, you have to play for real. Otherwise it's impossible.
Moms raising kids really have it rough. They must be exhausted every day.
Wanna try playing with them sometime...？
(Yeah...)
Kobayakawa
Lately, I've been having trouble raising a kid.
Raising a kid!？
My little brother, I mean.
Oh, man... Don't put it in such a weird way.
You're the one overreacting.
Anyway, is it a rebellious phase？ Sometimes he won't listen to me. It's rough.
It'll probably be even tougher when you have your own kids someday, ▲小早川＊▲.
You think so？ Right, if my brother's this hard, my own kid... I can't even imagine.
...Your kid, huh, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hey, don't go imagining it on your own.
Come on, why not？ Of course I'm curious.
Doesn't matter! No imagining allowed!
Kobayakawa
Kids are so moody. Just when I think they're rebelling, they get all clingy.
Oh, your brothers？ That sounds a lot like you though, ▲小早川＊▲.
Are you trying to say I'm childish？
I wouldn't go that far... but you get mad or clingy out of nowhere, don't you？
I don't get clingy. I keep my cool.
You do？
I do. Isn't it just how you're taking it？
You think so...？
You really don't let up... Oh, wait. Do you want me to get clingy with you？
That's not what I meant... but I do like it when you get clingy with me.
Hmm, I knew it. Fine, I'll be clingy—in moderation, and at the right time and place.
Haha, sure, sure.
Kobayakawa
There's a book I want, but I'm having a hard time finding it.
Did you try asking at a bookstore？
They said it's out of print.
That makes it tough to get. You could hunt for a used copy... or try an auction.
Hmm, I wonder if I can afford it on my allowance.
By the way, what book is it？
...Never mind that. You'll laugh at me.
(A book I'd laugh at...？ )
Kobayakawa
Looks like the publisher doesn't keep old books in stock after all.
Oh, the book you're after？ Why not try the used bookstore district？
The used bookstore district, huh...
I hear you can find some amazing hidden gems there sometimes.
...I see. I'll look into it. Thanks.
When his girlfriend's in trouble, it's a guy's job to help out! ...Right？
I'm really glad I have such a reliable boyfriend.
(Hm？ She's being awfully agreeable...)
Kobayakawa
I went to the used bookstore district the other day.
Did you find the book you were looking for？
No... But there was an old man at one shop who looked so hard for it. I was really touched.
Oh yeah？ That's really nice.
Yeah. He even asked around at other shops he knew. He was really kind.
Still, if he went that far and couldn't find it, it might be tough to track down.
He said he'd call me if it turns up, though... Honestly, I think I feel satisfied already.
Why？ You still want it, right？
Just having everyone go that far for me was enough. And of course, I'm grateful to my reliable boyfriend, too.
(I wonder what book it actually was...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, they found the book.
The book...？ Which one？
The one I was looking for. The shop called me—that old man actually found it for me!
Really？ That's great!
Yeah. Looks like I can afford it with my allowance, too, so that's a relief.
Good thing it wasn't super expensive. So, what book is it anyway？
Hmm...
Well, you don't have to tell me if you don't want to.
No, it's fine. ...Um, it's the very first book that was ever bought for me.
Oh, wow!
...I remembered it out of the blue and wanted to read it again. I searched all over the house, but it wasn't there.
A childhood favorite, huh. Good books are fun in a whole different way when you're older.
You're not gonna laugh？
Of course I wouldn't laugh.
I see... Well, I'll let you read it sometime, then. ...It's kind of embarrassing, so maybe later.
Kobayakawa
Lately, it seems a lot of girls are getting hit on in front of the station. And the guy's pretty persistent, apparently.
Are you okay, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah, I'm fine. Sweet of you to worry about me.
Of course. I'm worried you might kick the guy...
...Hey, who are you worried about here？
Both of you! Both of you!
...Well, whatever. Anyway, have you ever tried picking up girls？
Huh？ I've... never done that.
...Doesn't look like you're lying.
(I have nothing to feel guilty about... I think.)
Kobayakawa
When I walked past the station earlier, there really was a guy hitting on girls.
Oh, the one everyone's talking about.
Yeah, apparently it's just the one guy. People say it's always him hitting on girls.
He didn't bother you, did he？
Well, I was just watching from a distance. Besides, even if he did, you'd come rescue me, right？
Well, yeah, I would, but...
But？
I might not always make it there in time, you know.
Would that really happen？
Huh？ Uh... No, never!
Hehe, that's my boyfriend!
(I just made a pretty reckless promise...)
Kobayakawa
That guy hitting on girls in front of the station is turning into a big deal.
Even the teachers were telling the girls to watch out. You be careful too, okay, ▲小早川＊▲？
If he tries talking to me...
Whoa! Come on, I told you not to do that. It's dangerous, okay？
I know, I know. You really worry too much.
Still, does he really think girls are gonna like him if he's that pushy？
Guess he's never heard the saying, "If pushing doesn't work, try backing off."
Hmm, you sound awfully experienced with that stuff, don't you？
Huh？ ...It's just common sense.
Common sense, huh... Well, whatever.
(Man, that made me break into a cold sweat...)
Kobayakawa
The other day... somebody tried to pick me up in front of the station.
Wait, was it that guy everyone's talking about？ Are you okay？
Yeah. He said, "Pardon me, did you drop this kerchief？"
...Kerchief？
It was an old man.
Then that wasn't the pickup artist, was it...
Yeah, but when I talked to him... he said his grandson was in bed with a cold, so he was looking for the owner in his place.
...His grandson？
The old man's grandson is that guy who's been hitting on girls.
Oh! So he was just looking for the owner. Why didn't he just turn it in to the police box？
Apparently he fell in love at first sight seeing her from behind when she dropped her handkerchief. All he knows is that she goes to our high school.
(So his grandpa took over for him... Wait, is that actually a sweet story...？)
Kobayakawa
I saw your library checkout history. Don't you think you should read a little more？
...You think so？
You don't even come close to how much I read.
Well, yeah, if you compare me to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
There are only so many books you can read in a lifetime, you know. You have to use your time meaningfully.
Meaningfully, huh...
Want me to pick out some books for you for starters？
A ▲小早川＊▲ recommendation, huh. What do we have here？
"Middle School Required Reading."
...Oh, I've moved up a little since last time!
Good for you!
(...What am I getting so happy about？)
So, about the books you recommended, ▲小早川＊▲...
Kobayakawa
How was my required reading？
I haven't read them yet... Every last one of them is huge. I thought they were dictionaries.
I just picked books that'd be a good use of your time.
I'd prefer something easier to pick up and read. I can't even carry those around.
So picky. Fine, I'll give you something a bit lighter and more casual, for beginners.
...I'd appreciate that.
Well, I guess I can ease you into it bit by bit.
Nothing. Just saying you can look forward to it.
(Will it be okay...？)
Kobayakawa
How's the light version of my required reading？
Well, I did read it, but...
American literature isn't bad either, right？
...Not bad, maybe.
That "maybe" bothers me, though... Do you actually get it？
I can't really put my finger on why, I just thought it was good.
Well, I guess that's good enough.
Plus, it's really interesting to read while thinking about you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Huh？ What's that supposed to mean？
Like wondering what part of the book you liked, ▲小早川＊▲, or if this part made you laugh, or if it made you sad...
What is that...？ Come on... Ugh, I never should've recommended it to you.
(Maybe it makes her feel like I'm peeking inside her head...)
About that required reading of yours, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
...Just forget about that already.
I see...
...Quit making that face. What is it？
I tried to really understand it after that, but it was still too hard for me to get.
Right there.
Sorry.
You don't have to apologize. It's not like I wanted to force it on you.
I might've said this before, but we don't have to share all the same hobbies.
Just knowing you tried to understand me makes me happy.
Kobayakawa
Hehe.
In a good mood, huh？
They're doing a location test for the new Fight with Fear at the arcade by the station.
Fight...uh, what？
Fight with Fear. It's a fighting game. The first new one in ages, you know？
Huh... And what's a "location test"？
It's when select arcades get a trial version before the official release. What are you, an amateur？
I am an amateur...
Ugh, I can't wait to play it! It's been ages since I got this hyped for a fighting game.
(It really is rare to see ▲小早川＊▲ get this excited...)
Kobayakawa
I went to the FWF location test. Had to wait in a pretty long line, though.
F-W-F？
You know, the new fighting game.
Oh, Fight With...
Fear.
Right, that one. So, how was it？
I lost every single versus match...
It's a brand-new game, right？ You can't expect to win that easily.
The other players were in the same boat, though.
True... Maybe you were up against one of the devs playing incognito.
Oh, that could be it. They did seem a little too used to it... Well, next time I'm definitely not losing!
(Now that ▲小早川＊▲ has her sights set on them, there's no escaping her...)
Kobayakawa
...I can't get my feel for it back at all.
Hm？ What're you talking about？
The FWF series is supposed to be my specialty...
Oh. You're just talking about that fighting game.
It's not 'just' a game. Losing against another player makes me feel like I'm being rejected as a person.
That's a little dramatic.
I see myself in my K.O.'d character... I need to take a long, hard look at myself.
Just relax and have fun with it. It's only a game.
The invincibility frames... Are they still tweaking them or what...？
(She's not even listening...)
How's that new fighting game going since then？
Kobayakawa
The location test ended.
Oh, right.
Besides, I was already at my limit.
Your limit？
For financial reasons.
Gotcha. You're gonna play it once it's officially out, though, right？
Well, yeah. I got a decent feel for it, so until then I'll just practice on the last one at home.
Is it really that fun？
What, are you interested？
